headline: Moody's Revises Panama Credit Rating Outlook to Stable
summary: Moody's Ratings updated Panama's sovereign credit outlook to stable while preserving its investment-grade rating. The rating action reflects fiscal stabilization amid evolving political dynamics surrounding the Panama Canal.
why: Panama relies heavily on trade revenues from the Panama Canal and maintains an investment-grade credit profile crucial for Central American capital markets.

impacts.name: Panama
impacts.why: Revising the rating outlook to stable reduces immediate downgrade risks.
